openings: This Master Services Agreement is made between {{first}} (the "Supplier") and {{second}} (the "Customer").

The Supplier provides technology consulting, implementation and support services. This agreement sets out the general terms on which the Supplier will provide services to the Customer from time to time. Each engagement will be described in a statement of work signed by both parties, and each statement of work forms a separate contract incorporating these terms.
This agreement is entered into by {{second}} ("{{secondShort}}" or the "Customer") and {{first}} ("{{firstShort}}" or the "Supplier").

{{secondShort}} wishes to appoint {{firstShort}} as a non-exclusive provider of professional services over the term of this agreement. No services are ordered by this agreement itself: the Customer orders specific work by signing a statement of work, which states its scope, deliverables, timetable and fees, and these master terms govern every statement of work.

sections.heading: Services
variants: The Supplier shall perform the services described in each statement of work with reasonable skill and care, in accordance with good industry practice, and using appropriately qualified personnel.
The Customer shall give the Supplier reasonable access to its premises, systems and staff as the services require, and shall make decisions promptly where the Supplier needs them.

The Supplier shall provide the services in accordance with each statement of work and any service levels it sets out. If the Supplier expects to miss a milestone it shall notify the Customer promptly and propose a recovery plan.

sections.heading: Fees and Payment
variants: The Customer shall pay the fees set out in each statement of work. Unless a statement of work states otherwise, the Supplier shall invoice monthly in arrears and the Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty days of receipt.
Fees are charged on a time and materials basis at the rates in the relevant statement of work, unless it states a fixed price.
The Supplier may increase its rates once in each contract year by no more than the increase in the Consumer Prices Index, on sixty days' written notice.

sections.heading: Change Control
variants: Either party may request a change to a statement of work. No change is binding until both parties sign a written change note stating its effect on scope, timetable and fees.

The Customer may ask for changes to the services by written change request. The Supplier shall respond within ten working days with the impact of the change, and shall implement it only once the Customer accepts that impact in writing.

sections.heading: Liability
variants: Neither party limits its liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud. Subject to that, each party's total liability in each contract year is limited to the fees paid or payable in that year under all statements of work.

Neither party is liable for any indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit. Each party's aggregate liability under this agreement is capped at one hundred and twenty-five per cent of the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim.

sections.heading: Term and Termination
variants: This agreement runs for three years and then continues until either party gives six months' written notice. Termination of this agreement ends every statement of work then in force unless the parties agree otherwise.
Either party may terminate this agreement or any statement of work immediately by notice if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty days of being notified of it.
